## Construction and exact finite scope

All new declarations are in YulangClosure.BorrowedQualifiedReadReificationR67.
Borrowed carries the original complete R65 Inventory and unchanged sourceCalls /
schemaCoordinates payloads; there is no independently supplied mirror inventory.
occurrences is exact-equality, first-appearance eraseDups of the complete ordered
provenance occurrences. occurrence_index_reflect proves index equality iff exact
source equality whenever the left occurrence is present; the right may be absent.
occurrence_index_finite proves the in-table bound. Thus distinct exact occurrences
sharing a FactId survive, and absent/foreign exact keys cannot alias an encoded
in-table occurrence even if their local ordinal agrees.

complete_ordered_tables and edge_fields_preserved retain every fact, original
edge index, fact identity, slot, order and multiplicity, with indexed option-map
agreement. complete_competitors proves equality of the entire candidate lists;
no endpoint/fact/owner prefilter drops an extra competitor. resolve_commutes,
lookup_commutes and selected_lookup_commutes prove the total option-valued reads
commute, including failure. selected_fact_agreement exposes equality of identity,
lower/upper Terms and all four raw/canonical endpoint fields. These fields must
already exist in the input R65 interpretation; none is invented by the reifier.

valid computes all fact-position identities, all edge-position coordinates,
per-edge resolution and singleton source-key checks. invalid_edge_rejected,
invalid_fact_rejected and invalid_edge_index_rejected show checked rejection of
any bad complete-table row. This is owner-local validation, not a global FactId
uniqueness assumption. foreign_owner_rejected / foreign_lookup_rejected compare
opaque owner values before using local indices. accepted_reification preserves
owner, exact occurrence table, full inventory, source calls and schema payloads;
accepted_lookup_commutes and checked_lookup_commutes expose its read result.
The native interpretation of the opaque owner equality is still OPEN.

r66_selected_reads applies the result to the ACTUAL R66.Root and its existing
source/native/request premises. Its slot0 Internal and slot2 Lambda witnesses
are precisely those from R66.selected_root_has_qualified_source_reads; their full
FactRow values are retained in encodeRead. R66's original R49 Context and consumer
application are unchanged and retain all original ConsumerEvidence, ancestry,
Run/Checked/terminal premises. This packet supplies no new R49 Context extraction
or native execution witness.
